description: A gym's member app — class booking with door check-in, a training log and stats, memberships, personal training and a workout video library.

notes.1: First release: book group classes and check in with a rotating code, log gym visits by scanning the door code, a workout and step log with weekly minutes and your top 3 exercises, a loyalty level and a reward shop paid in coins earned by visiting, buying a membership or a single visit, requesting a personal trainer, news and a library of workouts and multi-week programmes. The front desk gets attendance, membership, PT and reward boards.
